title: Atlas'ın Origami Günlüğü
author: Hülya Biyan
description: Atlas is a curious, imaginative, and adventurous child who loves to travel. While browsing science magazines, he sees a horned whale, and his curiosity leads him into an adventure. He builds a whale from origami paper, begins to dream, and discovers that imagination can take him to places he cannot see. The story inspires readers to research unfamiliar living creatures and enrich their imagination and creativity.
